d: 3 AM In Nagpur is a powerful track where Naam Sujal delves into the hardships and unique lifestyle of his hometown, representing the resilience of his people. The title 3 AM symbolizes the darkness and struggles faced in Nagpur, capturing the raw, gritty essence of the city. As the song progresses, a sudden beat switch erupts into a raging moshpit, shifting the tone to one of fierce pride. This transition mirrors the city's unwavering spirit, showcasing both its challenges and the immense pride its people carry in their identity.
